title: Network Security Groups and Application Security Groups
body:
# Azure Virtual Networking and Application Security Groups Lab

In this lab, I implement a **virtual networking infrastructure in Azure** to support two groups of servers: **Web Servers** and **Management Servers**.

Each group is placed in its own **Application Security Group (ASG)** to enable **role-based traffic control** and improve network security.

## Configuration Objectives

The configuration ensures that:

- **Web Servers** are accessible over **HTTP** from the internet but do not allow **RDP** access.
- **Management Servers** are accessible over **RDP only** for administrative purposes.

This setup demonstrates how **Azure Application Security Groups and network security rules** can be used to enforce access controls based on server roles.
